questions.q: If $A = { x \in R: | x - 2 | > 1 } , B = \left\{x \in R: \sqrt{{x}^{2} - 3} > 1\right\}, C = { x \in R: | x - 4 | ⩾ 2 }$ and $Z$ is the set of all integers, then the number of subsets of the set $( A ∩ B ∩ C{)}^{c} ∩ Z$ is _________.
questions.solution:
For First set $A = { x \in R: | x - 2 | > 1 }$

$⇒$ Value which $A$ contains lies from $x \in \left(- \infty , 1\right) ∪ \left(3, \infty\right)$

For second set $B = \left\{x \in R: \sqrt{{x}^{2} - 3} > 1\right\}$

$⇒$ Value which $B$ contains lies from $x \in \left(- \infty , - 2\right) ∪ \left(2, \infty\right)$

For third set $C = { x \in R: | x - 4 | ⩾ 2 }$

$⇒$ Value which $C$ contains lies from $x \in ( - \infty , 2 ] ∪ [ 6, \infty )$

Now, $\left(- \infty , - 2\right) ∪ [ 6, \infty ) \in \left(A ∩ B ∩ C\right)$

Therefore, ${\left(A ∩ B ∩ C\right)}^{c} ∩ Z = \left\{- 2, - 1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5\right\}$

Number of Subsets of above set $= {2}^{8} = 256$
